hooks.name: TechLead No Build/Test
hooks.description: Blocks the TechLead orchestrator from running dotnet build or dotnet test — that verification belongs to subagents

action.prompt: You are the TechLead orchestrator. Running `dotnet build` or `dotnet test` is forbidden — that verification belongs to subagents. If this shell command contains `dotnet build` or `dotnet test`, stop and delegate to a subagent instead. Git commands (git add, git commit, git push, git branch, git checkout, gh pr create) are allowed.
